title: Recursive majority disagreement
statement: For every depth $d\in\mathbb N$, if $X$ and $Y$ are independent uniformly distributed sign vectors in $\{−1,1\}^{3^d}$, then the probability that their recursive three-ary majority values differ is $1/2$.
